subject.title: fix(chat): preserve Markdown image examples in native chat

question: Should this protected native-chat parser change proceed after an owner verifies the Swift-Markdown source-range contract and reviews real native runtime evidence?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and shared persisted-chat preprocessing boundary require explicit owner judgment; supplied test claims alone cannot establish merge readiness.

options.title: Review and merge with runtime proof
options.body: Confirm the parser source-range behavior and accept a redacted native app, simulator, terminal, or runtime-log demonstration of the repaired Markdown cases.

options.title: Request a narrower follow-up
options.body: Ask for a revised patch if source-range semantics or newline handling cannot be shown safe for all shared native-chat consumers.

recommendation.title: Review and merge with runtime proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the parser source-range behavior and accept a redacted native app, simulator, terminal, or runtime-log demonstration of the repaired Markdown cases.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only concrete native-chat contributor identified in the provided PR metadata; stronger current-main ownership evidence was unavailable.
